description: Use this when the person asks about the waves, wind or conditions at one spot. Not for comparing spots: use find_best_surf. Not for tides: use get_tide_times. Answers one spot's forecast: now, its next good window, each of the next days (at most 16) with its best hours, and hour by hour the wave height, swell period and direction, wind speed and direction (offshore or onshore at this spot), and sunrise and sunset; each number names its source and when it was made.

spot.description: a surf spot's id as search_surf_spots or list_surf_spots_near show it, or its name (Ericeira, Supertubos, Hossegor)

name: get_surf_forecast
title: Get a surf forecast
